method: Reviewed full draft against the Ministry of the Interior and Safety press release on electric heating appliance fires (NFA national fire information system: 2,390 fires over five years, 344 casualties with 48 deaths, 994 fires in December-January equal to 42%, causes: carelessness 45%, electrical factors 31%, mechanical factors 19%), the NKAT/e-Nara standard page for KS C IEC 60529 (IP code, IEC 60529 identical), the Korea Electrical Safety Corporation safety guidance (residual current breaker test button monthly, wet hands ban, caution on using electrical products in bathrooms), the Ministry of Government Legislation easy-law page for the KEPCO residential low-voltage tariff (910/120.0, 1,600/214.6, 7,300/307.3 KRW, fund 2.7%) and the KEPCO bill calculator method page. Product consumption ratings come from the Shinil SEH-B1500WG listing (1,100-1,500W, waterproof, KC HU071837-23019A), a bathroom lamp heater spec (275W x 3 lamps = 825W), the Mill official product page (1,000W, IPX4 approved for bathrooms) and the Danawa explainer on radiant vs convection heating. The monthly incremental bill table (0.5h x 30 days, tariff bands 151.0/257.6/362.1 KRW per kWh including climate 9.0, fuel adjustment 5.0, VAT 10% and fund 2.7%) is reproduced in the research record calculations. Range notations in the draft (1100-1500W, 12-23kWh, 5-10%, 2018-2022) are additionally covered as concatenated tokens in the research values for the gate's range parser.
